summary:
Frontend-only polish verification for markdown/katex rendering and scroll containers. 3 of 4 targets PASS. Ask-AI answer + QA solutions render clean formatted text with scrollable containers (max-h-[46vh] and max-h-[75vh] with overflow-y-auto confirmed; QA scrollHeight 1769 > clientHeight 808). AI Tutor bubble renders full markdown+KaTeX (16 katex nodes, 8 bold, no raw ** or LaTeX slashes). Regression clean: no React runtime errors, no white screen, katex CSS loads. FAILURE: VideoSolutionPlayer whiteboard lines are NOT rendered through the new Markdown component - the file imports Markdown but line 53 still renders `{line}` as plain text inside

. .md-body-invert count = 0 in DOM. The cached Paper 2 board content happens to be free of markdown symbols so no visible artifacts appear today, but any future response containing **bold** / \[ \] / \( \) / $...$ will render raw exactly like the pre-fix bug. Also, .md-body-invert CSS class is referenced in the request but no element uses it.

ui_bugs.issue:
Board lines rendered as raw text via

{line}

(line 53). Markdown component is imported but never used for board content. Regression against the stated fix - future AI outputs containing markdown/LaTeX will show raw ** and \[ \] symbols on the whiteboard. Fix: wrap each line in {line} (keep the fade/translate transition on a wrapper div).

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/VideoSolutionPlayer.jsx, replace the plain `{line}` render on line 53 with the Markdown component using the md-body-invert class so whiteboard text renders formatted markdown+math (matches PaperReader/AITutor treatment).
critical_code_review_comments: VideoSolutionPlayer imports Markdown but never invokes it - dead import and unfulfilled requirement.
Markdown.jsx currently forces `md-body` class; to support the md-body-invert variant on the dark whiteboard, either drop the hardcoded prefix or merge with className prop cleanly.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4/5 review points; video whiteboard Markdown wiring missing)

seed_data_creation: Reused existing student session (user_teststudent01 / test_session_student_01) confirmed in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cached fast IDs: Paper1 QA pap_71501c2ba7f8, Paper2 video pap_68b3f5254f5e. Routes are /study/paper/:id (NOT /paper/:id). AI tutor route /ai uses an <input placeholder='Ask GC AI anything...'> and Enter to send. Highlight-to-Ask flow can be triggered by selecting a span in .react-pdf__Page__textContent and dispatching a 'mouseup' event on the scrollable ancestor with class max-h-[75vh]. After fix, re-check .md-body-invert exists inside .bg-[#0A192F] and confirm no raw ** / \[ / \( appears when boards contain math.
rca_of_the_issue:
The polish task added a Markdown wrapper and md-body-invert CSS variant, and wired PaperReader.jsx + AITutor.jsx to use them. VideoSolutionPlayer.jsx was updated to import Markdown but the JSX inside the board map (line 51-55) was never changed - each scene line is still rendered as a raw string inside

. This is a plain incomplete implementation, not a plugin/config issue.
